text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed. In supervised learning, a model is trained using labelled examples called training data. Each example contains an input and the correct output. During training, the model looks for patterns that connect them. Once training is complete, the model can make predictions about new, unseen data. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy — the percentage of correct answers. Good training data and the right model usually lead to better accuracy. Machine learning is now used in many areas, such as email filtering, recommendation systems, and medical diagnosis.
